_README: RotoWire team abbreviation -> the abbreviation master_team uses.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The lineup scorer joins captures to games on (ET date, home,
away). Where the two sources spell a team differently the join returns nothing, and a
game that silently fails to resolve is INDISTINGUISHABLE from a game with no capture.
That is the same failure M39 s03 shipped once already, where a broken join was written
up as the finding 'no games moved'.
PHO -> PHX was already handled in code. POR -> PDX was NOT, and would have dropped
every Portland game starting with the 2026-08-25 slate.
DELIBERATELY INCOMPLETE. Only mappings actually OBSERVED on the page are recorded.
